root_cause: The merged hourly supervisor telemetry projected CAS and drift messages but omitted the actual GitHub runtime annotation for a missing exact terminal PR writer lease. As observed on #4772 and #4778, green exact-head checks do not grant authority to update an ACTIVE or CANDIDATE lease.
fix: Match strict real timestamped GitHub warning annotations, dedupe by exact provider run ID and PR, and report distinct-run missing terminal leases in the existing read-only hourly Janitor evidence.
prevention_rule: No supervisor log observation may promote a PR, change branch metadata, retry GitHub Actions, or infer a writer lease release. Only the existing writer may release its lease, and native update-branch must enforce expected-head CAS. Missing/partial provider evidence must not become green.

invariants: No production/customer value claim from logs
